title.narrative: AUC 2022-2025 Support to the AU-MISAHEL Office

description.narrative:
The lack of development in the sub-region over the years has likely impaired the ability of existing governments to meet the needs of their citizens. This has been particularly noticeable through population growth, as well as environmental, economic, political, and security tensions, which have led to a decline in the quality of life of the population.
The overall objective of the African Union Strategy for Sustainable Peace and Integrated Development in the Sahel aims at achieving sustainable peace and integrated development through:
- Promoting the rule of law and strengthening democratic institutions
- Promoting regional security cooperation; and
- Coordinating integrated development initiatives.

Det övergripande målet för Afrikanska unionens strategi för hållbar fred och integrerad utveckling i Sahel är att uppnå hållbar fred och integrerad utveckling genom:
- Främja rättsstatsprincipen och stärka de demokratiska institutionerna.
- främja regionalt säkerhetssamarbete, och
- samordna initiativ för integrerad utveckling.
